rows.en:
{C:8193A702}{C:819582969E2C00000000}Bear! Bear!
Let's go over there next!

{C:8193C902}{C:819582969F2C00000000}How many times do I have to tell you?!
I'm not a bear! I'm Teddyam!

{C:8193A702}{C:81958296A02C00000000}Oh, Bear!
I want to see over there too!

{C:8193C802}{C:81958296A12C00000000}Ah ha ha ha ha ha!
Even Teddyam's
met their match!

{C:8193C602}{C:81958296A22C00000000}Good grief. What a handful this young lady is.

{C:8193C702}{C:81958296A32C00000000}We're in a bind.
At this rate, we can't go
and look for Toya and the others.



{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42C00000000}If I remember right, they said Toya,
the one Greyfus and the others are looking for,
wears clothes that show his belly button.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296A52C00000000}A belly-baring look, huh?
That sounds pretty uncool.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296A62C00000000}Like that, you mean?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296A72C00000000}Damn, going after a child and a baby!
What a bunch of bastards!

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296A92C00000000}Toya,
don't those people watching over there
look like the ones we heard about?

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296AA2C00000000}One, two... The number's exactly right too.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296E60000000000}Things are starting
to look pretty bad...


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296AB2C00000000}Hey, you bastards!
You're those Troopers who kidnapped
a girl called Natsumi, aren't you?!

{C:81958296AC2C00000000}Spit out where she is,
or I'll beat the hell out of you!

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296AD2C00000000}What?! You're saying
we kidnapped Natsumi?!

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296AE2C00000000}Toya! Kira!
These people aren't evil!

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296AF2C00000000}Don't let them fool you!
They're the mortal enemies of Arago,
who's trying to protect the world!

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296B02C00000000}Teddyam! Everyone!
Please fight alongside us!

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296B12C00000000}What do we do, Greyfus?

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296B22C00000000}I'm siding with Kira.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296B42C00000000}It can't be helped.
For now, we have no choice
but to fight while holding back.






{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B62C00000000}Haaah!
Stop it, you fools!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296B72C00000000}Master?!

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296B92C00000000}Master Asia!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BA2C00000000}What you should be doing
is not fighting each other!
Join hands and fight together!

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296BB2C00000000}What are you talking about, old man?!
I'll send you flying with my warrior powers!

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296BC2C00000000}Stop, Toya!
That man is... strong!

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296BD2C00000000}Master Asia,
we have no intention of listening to you,
not after you abducted Natsumi!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BE2C00000000}That's why you're fools!
If I hadn't claimed to abduct her
and taken her away, who would protect her?!

{C:81958296BF2C00000000}You lot are
immature! Utterly immature!

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296C12C00000000}What did you say?!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296C22C00000000}If that stings, gather more allies,
including those called {C:819782830400}Dagwon{C:819782830000} on the other continents, and storm
{C:819782830300}Arago Castle{C:819782830000}!

{C:81958296C32C00000000}Once Arago has been defeated,
Natsumi and Mirai's safety is guaranteed!
Understood, all of you?!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296C42C00000000}Well, what do we do, everyone?
Do we listen to Master Asia?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296C62C00000000}I believe my master.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296E70000000000}Me too.
I think we can trust him.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296C72C00000000}I can't believe him.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296C82C00000000}Neither can I.
It looks like we agree
on that, at least!

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296C92C00000000}Why don't we travel together
and find out whether it's true?

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296CA2C00000000}Will adding them put too much
strain on the Astante II?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB2C00000000}That'll be fine.

{C:81958296CC2C00000000}But what about you?
Do you want to come with us?

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296CD2C00000000}There's Konoha to think about too.
Wouldn't it be safer to go together?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296CE2C00000000}Why don't we look for Dagwon
first, at any rate?
We can decide after that.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296CF2C00000000}He did say they were on other continents.
Getting a ride on the Astante II
would be safest, boss.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296D02C00000000}You're right...
With Konoha to think about too,
we'll take you up on your help.

{C:81958296D12C00000000}We'll go get Konoha
and come to your ship, then.
See you later.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C202}{C:81958296E90000000000}Master!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D22C00000000}Rai? What is it?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296EA0000000000}Was that all right?
Telling them so much?
Isn't it too soon...?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D42C00000000}Perhaps it is.
But that was the only way
to calm those fools down, wouldn't you say?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296EB0000000000}I do think
you're right, Master.
But if the Yoja find out, your position...

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D52C00000000}Heh... There's no need to worry.
Still, you were the only one
who understood my intentions from the start.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296EC0000000000}That was just chance.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D62C00000000}Well, all we can do is pray
that they join forces.



{x00}

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296D72C00000000}Well, what an interesting place
to meet such interesting people.

{C:81958296D82C00000000}How convenient.
For Lord Arago's sake,
you can all die here!




{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DA2C00000000}You fight enemies like that?
You and your friends are amazing, Ryo.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296DB2C00000000}Not really.
On the other hand, we're completely hopeless
at piloting machines.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DC2C00000000}Exactly.
Everyone has their own strengths.
Don't let it bother you.




{x00}

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296DD2C00000000}We've come for that ride you promised.

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296DE2C00000000}Thank you for having us.
And this is
Konoha Maihara.

{C:8190C502}{C:81958296DF2C00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Konoha Maihara{C:819782830000}.
I'm sorry for the trouble.





{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192C00000000}Shall we stop and rest here?

{C:8190D101}{C:819582961A2C00000000}We mustn't.
This is a {C:819782830300}bar{C:819782830000}, so it's not a place
we should be going into.

{C:8190D801}{C:819582961B2C00000000}Oh, that voice!

{C:8190D101}{C:819582961D2C00000000}Rasid?
It's you, Rasid!

{C:8190D801}{C:819582961E2C00000000}We've been looking for you, Master Quatre!
The entire {C:819782830400}Maganac{C:819782830000} Corps
is here.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193B801}{C:81958296660100000000}Hey, Wufei,
are you always like that?

{C:8193D201}{C:81958296C43300000000}Like what?

{C:8193B801}{C:81958296670100000000}Your shoulders always seem
so tense, you know.
Doesn't it wear you out?

{C:8193D201}{C:81958296C63300000000}This is who I am.
Nothing more, nothing less.
Strength is all that's expected of me.

{C:8193B801}{C:81958296680100000000}Hmm... Is that so?
I couldn't do it.
I'd definitely get tired.

{C:81958296690100000000}I've got a goal too,
but there's no point getting worn out
before you achieve it.

{C:8193D201}{C:81958296C83300000000}A goal...

{C:81958296C93300000000}(What is my goal now...?)



{x00}

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296352C00000000}Norman!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296362C00000000}Whoa! That startled me...
Oh, it's Roger.
What's he so angry about?

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296372C00000000}What in the world
have you been doing all this time?
I've been looking everywhere for you!

{C:8190A402}{C:81958296382C00000000}My apologies.
The Posaydal Army
had been dragging me around.

{C:81958296392C00000000}When I arrived here, the Posaydal Army
withdrew, leaving me stranded
and at my wits' end.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582963A2C00000000}I see. I'm sorry.
Now that we've met up here,
you should come aboard the Astante II.

{C:8190A402}{C:819582963B2C00000000}Certainly, Master Roger.







{x00}

{C:81909200}{C:81958296162B00000000}Jerid!
Wait, Jerid!
I need to talk to you.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296172B00000000}What is it, Mouar?

{C:81909200}{C:81958296182B00000000}How long do you intend
to keep chasing the Astante?

{C:81908F00}{C:819582961A2B00000000}Until I settle things once and for all!
I won't be satisfied otherwise!


{x00}
rows.notes: All25unique482verdicts,fourshared,eightactualauthorgroupsandassessments,threefullJP-current-proposedsevenfieldupdatesread. Repairs5/18/20;other22whole467exact. rows.en:
{C:81939200}{C:819582961B2B00000000}Listen, Jerid.
Are you really all right with that?
You understand the situation we're in, don't you?

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961D2B00000000}I do!
That's why I'm...

{C:81939200}{C:819582961E2B00000000}Even if it only benefits Scirocco... no,
the person behind him,
and no one else?

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961F2B00000000}What are you trying to say, Mouar?

{C:81939200}{C:81958296212B00000000}As things stand, you're just being used.
Shouldn't you think about the future
and take a different course?

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296222B00000000}Think about the future... huh.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296242B00000000}You were the one
with Chirico, weren't you?
Do you remember me?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296252B00000000}Um, Gregore, was it?
But Chirico said you were dead...

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296272B00000000}Hey, don't go killing me off!
I'm alive and kicking, as you can see.
Anyway, I've got a proposal.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296282B00000000}A proposal?
Do you mean you want to join us?

{C:8190DC00}{C:819582962A2B00000000}You're quick on the uptake!
I'm not as good as Chirico,
but I think I could be useful.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962B2B00000000}Are you sure?
Risking your hard-won life...

{C:8190DC00}{C:819582962E2B00000000}Until now, I was as good as dead.
From now on, I'll fight to live.
It's a good idea, right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302B00000000}That's a positive way of looking at it.
All right,
I'll speak to Rie about it.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296332B00000000}Yeah, I'm counting on you.







{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296342B00000000}A lot of people around here wear
pilot suits like yours, Chirico.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296372B00000000}They're practically an AT pilot's uniform.
It's nothing unusual.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296392B00000000}Someone's watching us.
Do you know them?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582963A2B00000000}That's... Carson!
It's you, Carson!

{C:8190DF00}{C:819582963C2B00000000}Chirico!
Now, none of that tactless
'So you're alive?' business from either of us!

{C:8190C800}{C:819582963E2B00000000}No... I'm glad you're alive.
So, what are you doing now?

{C:8190DF00}{C:819582963F2B00000000}I'm listed as killed in action,
so I've been quietly watching the war engulf the world
from a distance.

{C:81958296402B00000000}It's a dull life.
You've got it good, Chirico,
with a beauty by your side.


{C:8190C800}{C:81958296432B00000000}Stop teasing...
More importantly, if you're bored,
why not fight with us?

{C:8190DF00}{C:81958296442B00000000}Fight with you?
You can't mean...!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296472B00000000}That's exactly what I mean.
What do you say, Carson?

{C:8190DF00}{C:81958296482B00000000}That sounds interesting.
Yes, very interesting.
But is it all right?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582964A2B00000000}It's all right, isn't it?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B2B00000000}Of course!
Especially since you're someone
Chirico invited.

{C:8190DF00}{C:819582964C2B00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Virgil Carson{C:819782830000}.
Good to meet you.








{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190DD00}{C:819582964D2B00000000}You there, woman!
Let me see Chirico Cuvie!

{C:81905700}{C:819582964E2B00000000}Who are you?
Only authorized personnel are allowed in here.

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582964F2B00000000}Go get Chirico, now!
Or I'll let myself in.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296502B00000000}Absolutely not!


{C:81902201}{C:81958296512B00000000}What's wrong, Leccee?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296522B00000000}Oh, Eiji.
This person says to get Chirico.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296542B00000000}Oh, in that case,
I'll go fetch him.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296552B00000000}That's not the point!
Oh, he's gone...

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296562B00000000}Pfft... Ah ha ha ha ha!
What an amusing fellow.
I haven't laughed like that in ages.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296572B00000000}I agree.
Eiji's a good boy.

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296582B00000000}...
I'm sorry for threatening you.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296592B00000000}I heard someone was asking for me...
...Murza? You managed to survive.

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582965C2B00000000}I don't know why I survived.
But as long as I'm alive,
fighting is all I have left.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582965E2B00000000}Do you want to come with us?

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582965F2B00000000}Of course!






{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296602B00000000}A bar... It's no place
for a minor like me...

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296612B00000000}I've been waiting for you, kid.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296622B00000000}Byman!
